noticias.titulo: Stock market today: Nasdaq and S&P 500 rebound, Dow slips to cap bruising week for AI stocks
noticias.resumo: Iren shares jumped as much as 20% on Friday, rebounding from a roughly 17% decline in the previous session amid a broader sell-off in the AI trade.  Despite the recovery, Iren shares remain down more than 50% year to date as investor concerns over AI infrastructure spending, financing requirements and data center expansion have weighed on the sector.  The company, which has transitioned from bitcoin (BTC-USD) mining into AI cloud and data center infrastructure, has been particularly affected by the recent pullback in neocloud stocks.
